card.title: Credit for the Impossible
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you understood, predicted, or accepted the impossible truth before anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I believed the cupboard before it learned to speak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One quick acknowledgment, then I'll respect its wishes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says you talk too much.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An informed opinion formed over years of my support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I believed this cupboard could speak when you wanted it scrapped. Say I was first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whisper it. Then we can both respect its wishes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write it, then. 'You believed before any of us.' I'll put it beside its first words.

mechanism: A obtains explicit priority credit for believing a cupboard could speak before others accepted it.
confusable: Unlike defending long-term loyalty generally, A must secure acknowledgment of having understood the impossible first.
comparison: The recovered candidate switches from whispered to written recognition under a silence constraint; protected D153-a is not newly assessed.
